title: 第15章 镇魂钉第16章 全员傻眼
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
“道友，切莫小看了那邪灵！
这家伙看起来不强，但是极度危险！”
黄长老似乎看出了罗天的心思，出声提醒道。
“都给我安静，别干扰我师父施法！”
一个年轻人，对着黄长老呵斥道。
论年纪，他看起来也就二十几岁的样子。
但是黄长老，就硬是不敢还嘴。
没办法，谁让人家是魂师的弟子呢。
法台之上，魂师苏老燃起一团黄钱纸。
呼！
霎时间，四周的绿色火焰飘飞而起。
四下里，更是传来阵阵鬼哭狼嚎的声音。
数百道魂影，开始在他头顶汇聚。
“镇魂钉，现！”
苏老喝道。
铿！
下一瞬，一根一尺长的镇魂钉，浮现在他头顶。
“那是……魂力化形？好强大！”
“开玩笑的吧？魂力化形……竟然真有这么强大的高手？”
地明宗众人，全都面露震惊之色。

只有罗天，一阵无语。
“这个……至于这样么？”
他开口问道。
黄长老听了，在一旁低声道：“道友不是魂修，所以不懂也正常！
魂力修为，极为困难，只有一些大能为者，才能做到魂力化形！”
罗天微微一笑，也不多言。
反正自己就是来求取千年钟乳的，何必多言呢？
“杀！”
另一边，苏老挥手，空中的镇魂钉，猛的朝邪灵冲去，重重的撞在一起。
“嗷！”
邪灵发出一声凄厉的嚎叫，朝着镇魂钉冲了过去。
当！
一声巨响，直穿灵魂。
场间一些修为不足的年轻弟子，直接被震得口吐白沫，晕厥过去。
“这魂力波动……”
黄长老眉头紧皱，转头看着罗天。
可后者却是面无表情，一点反应都没有。
“好定力。”
黄长老不禁赞叹道。
另一边，苏老驾驭着镇魂钉，不断轰击邪灵，将邪灵压得连连后退。

“好！
师父再加一把力，干掉这邪祟！”
content_en:
"Fellow Taoist, don't underestimate that evil spirit!
This guy doesn't look strong, but he is extremely dangerous! "
Elder Huang seemed to have noticed Luo Tian's thoughts and reminded him aloud.
"Everyone, please be quiet and don't interfere with my master's spellcasting!"
A young man yelled at Elder Huang.
In terms of age, he looked to be in his twenties.
But Elder Huang just didn't dare to talk back.
There is no way, who would let someone be a disciple of a soul master?
On the altar, Soul Master Su Lao lit a ball of yellow money paper.
call!
In an instant, green flames flew up all around.
From all around, there were sounds of ghosts crying and wolves howling.
Hundreds of soul shadows began to gather above his head.
"Soul-suppressing nail, appear!"
Mr. Su shouted.
Keng!
The next moment, a foot-long soul-suppressing nail appeared above his head.
"That's...soul power transformed? So powerful!"
"Are you kidding me? Soul power transformed... is there really such a powerful master?"
Everyone in the Di Ming Sect looked shocked.
Only Luo Tian was speechless for a while.
"This...is this what it is?"
he asked.
Elder Huang heard this and whispered from the side: "Fellow Taoist is not a soul cultivator, so it's normal that he doesn't understand!
Cultivation of soul power is extremely difficult. Only some powerful people can achieve the transformation of soul power! "
Luo Tian smiled slightly and didn't say much.
Anyway, I am here to ask for the thousand-year stalactite, so why should I say more?
"Kill!"
On the other side, Mr. Su waved his hand, and the soul-suppressing nails in the air rushed towards the evil spirits, and they collided heavily with each other.
"Ouch!"
The evil spirit let out a shrill howl and rushed towards the soul-suppressing nail.
when!
A loud sound pierced through the soul.
Some young disciples with insufficient cultivation in the field were shocked to the point where they foamed at the mouth and fainted.
"This fluctuation in soul power..."
Elder Huang frowned and turned to look at Luo Tian.
But the latter was expressionless and showed no reaction at all.
"Good concentration."
Elder Huang couldn't help but admired.
On the other side, Mr. Su controlled the soul-suppressing nail and continuously bombarded the evil spirits, forcing them to retreat continuously.
"Okay!
Master, please use more strength to kill this evil spirit! "
